DISCOVERY.question: What are the top-level directories in the SNAPKITTYWEST/autoware repository and what is the purpose of each?
DISCOVERY.answer: repositories/ — VCS manifest .repos files (autoware.repos, simulator.repos, tools.repos, nightly variants) listing all sub-repos to clone via the vcs tool; docker/ — layered Dockerfile hierarchy (base → core → universe ± CUDA) plus docker-bake.hcl and example compose files; ansible/ — Ansible roles and playbooks for environment provisioning (ROS 2, CUDA, TensorRT, agnocast, ML model artifacts, build tools, version locking); .github/workflows/ — CI/CD automation (docker-build-and-push, health-check, regenerate-lockfiles, bump-repo-versions, watch-huggingface-hub-major); src/ — empty placeholder directory populated at build time via vcs import src < repositories/autoware.repos; .devcontainer/ — VS Code devcontainer configs for core-devel, universe-devel, and universe-devel-cuda images.
DISCOVERY.evidence: File tree from git/trees/HEAD recursive; src/README.md: 'the autoware repository itself does not contain the full source code. Instead, it references many separately maintained repositories'; TRAINING/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md confirms this structure

DISCOVERY.question: What ROS 2 distributions and target Ubuntu versions does Autoware support?
DISCOVERY.answer: Two distributions: ROS 2 Humble targeting Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy) and ROS 2 Jazzy targeting Ubuntu 24.04 (Noble). The docker-bake.hcl sets ROS_DISTRO default to jazzy. The health-check workflow matrix covers both: main/amd64/humble, main-arm64/arm64/humble, main-jazzy-amd64/amd64/jazzy, main-jazzy-arm64/arm64/jazzy. Locked version files exist for all four combinations: locked-versions-humble-amd64.yaml, locked-versions-humble-arm64.yaml, locked-versions-jazzy-amd64.yaml, locked-versions-jazzy-arm64.yaml.
DISCOVERY.evidence: docker/docker-bake.hcl: variable ROS_DISTRO { default = 'jazzy' }; BASE_IMAGE_DIGESTS has keys humble and jazzy; .github/workflows/health-check.yaml matrix block; ansible/vars/ directory listing

DISCOVERY.question: What sub-repository categories does repositories/autoware.repos define?
DISCOVERY.answer: Five categories: (1) core/ — foundational packages: agnocast v2.3.5, autoware_msgs v1.13.0, autoware_adapi_msgs v1.9.2, autoware_internal_msgs v1.15.0, autoware_cmake v1.4.0, autoware_utils v1.10.0, autoware_lanelet2_extension v1.2.0, autoware_core v1.9.0, autoware_rviz_plugins v0.6.0, autoware_simple_planning_simulator v1.0.0, autoware_system_designer v0.4.2; (2) universe/ — autoware_universe v0.52.1 plus external deps (tier4_autoware_msgs v0.70.0-rc, cuda_blackboard v0.4.0, managed_transform_buffer v0.2.0, bevdet_vendor v0.1.0, eagleye, muSSP, glog, negotiated); (3) launcher/ — autoware_launch v0.52.0; (4) sensor_component/ — nebula v1.1.0 (sensor drivers), ros2_socketcan, transport_drivers, sensor_component_description.

DISCOVERY.question: What Docker image must be used for the AWSIM end-to-end simulator demo and what are its GPU requirements?
DISCOVERY.answer: The AWSIM demo uses ghcr.io/autowarefoundation/autoware:universe-cuda-jazzy. Requirements: runtime: nvidia, NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all, NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all, privileged: true, and a Docker deploy.resources.reservations with driver: nvidia. The demo maps are mounted from ${HOME}/autoware_data/maps and ml_models from ${HOME}/autoware_data/ml_models. The launch command is: ros2 launch autoware_launch e2e_simulator.launch.xml vehicle_model:=sample_vehicle sensor_model:=awsim_sensor_kit map_path:=/home/aw/autoware_data/maps/Shinjuku-Map/map.
DISCOVERY.evidence: docker/examples/demos/awsim/docker-compose.yaml: image, runtime: nvidia, NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all, deploy.resources.reservations.devices driver: nvidia, command block
